Employment History.aboutRole:
Built entire skincare web-app from scratch using Reactjs, which offers AI based skin scores.The
main C++ logic was communicated with using the NAPI module. Handle concurrent requests using the node cluster module (PM2) and reduce api response time by 30% with worker threads.
Scale the super-enhance API to handle 500 images/min across 6 geographic locations. Created a
dashboard to track api requests. Utilised time-triggered Azure functions to store API responses.
Built the whole backend rest API's for superink including the database architecture from scratch, which enables AI-based image tagging and generates nine various types of content. Third-party
API integration, such as sendgrid and the razorpay payment gateway.
Built the full backend rest API's, including the database structure from scratch, for managing
Amazon multiple image requests, which must be routed through padding cropping, background
removal, and super resolution apis built in python. Integrated third part api magic clipping.
Handled each stage of the deployment procedure, including setting up the host file, pointing the
domain at the server, and delivering the application via Docker. Integrated Winston logger for logging. Worked on docker volume for generating so file for various ubuntu versions.

Created an alert system that tells the user if traffic lowers or rises above a given threshold. Using
a third-party API call, save the monthly traffic data of 1000 ASNs with three different traffic
directions. Use python libraries like pandas, numpy and requests. Store data in SQL database.
Created a tool that would deliver a detailed report on a certain consumer over the last three
months. This report will cover traffic from customers to customers, peers to peers, and peers to customers. Developed a python script to produce comprehensive reports.
Developed a web application that displays the total capacity subscribed by each peer connected to Tata Communications in a separate region. The peering manager can also have admin access
and choose whether the data should be kept private or made available to other teams.
My job was to design the complete webapp, including the frontend and backend.
